answer.summary: Read the actual retrospective result together with feature-availability and target limitations.

items.title: Measured primary holdout result
items.text: The saved national raw-poultry primary-sample evaluation has 48,361 training rows and 23,472 holdout rows. Historical baseline Brier is 0.08855575; logistic Brier is 0.08859440; logistic ROC-AUC is 0.498029. Lower Brier means lower squared probability error for this defined sampling task.
uncertainty: This measures selected-sample positivity, not consumer illness probability, farm safety or an individualized shipment forecast.

items.title: Complexity is not evidence of useful skill
items.text: The baseline has lower or equal Brier error than logistic regression in this saved primary holdout. Inspect calibration, uncertainty, target definition and actual feature-availability dates before claiming an operational forecast.
items.provenance: comparison of the recorded evaluation metrics
uncertainty: No new accuracy figure, training run or prospective validation is created by this summary.

items.title: Feature availability remains a separate question
items.text: A collection-date reporting lag or snapshot-creation date is not proof of first public availability. The current application does not establish a validated prospective illness forecast. Keep FSIS outcomes, CDC BEAM surveillance and NORS outbreaks distinct unless a defensible linkage is demonstrated.
uncertainty: The assistant does not infer missing publication dates or genomic relationships from shared labels.

items.title: Use Drive while safely parked
items.text: Drive starts locked. Its server-checked parked attestation is self-declared and expires after ten minutes. Reporting and acknowledgments require the current truck/trip context. No actual motion, GPS or physical fuel/cargo sensor is detected.

items.title: Keep reports and dispatcher authority separate
items.text: A driver report reaches the local dispatcher inbox without automatically rerouting or holding cargo. A human may review, hold/release a lot or issue a versioned instruction.
